plugins.name: Chords & notes
plugins.description: Type or import guitar chords with lyrics for the playing song — Ultimate Guitar links paste straight in. Chord diagrams for guitar or ukulele. Private per user.

plugins.name: Intelligent Shuffle
plugins.description: A dynamic DJ for your library: vote more or less like this while it plays, and the queue re-deals to the mood. Reads each track's own genres, era and energy, takes requests in plain words, and works out whether you mean the band or the vibe. Votes fade over hours, so it follows tonight, not last week.
